intent: A 2-3 minute product video for @instafill_ai aimed at REAL ESTATE AGENTS rather than at appraisers: the same Residential BPO form and the same synthetic Cantrell dataset the 9:14 walkthrough (neaCnEawvbk) used, re-recorded and re-cut under the angle 'how real estate agents automate paperwork with AI'. Plus one vertical short cut from it. Recorded SILENT -- the narration is a written ElevenLabs voice-over, not a live take.

form.breakdown: 455 text, 78 button, 1 choice -- measured with pypdf, which is where the '500+ fields' claim in the old video comes from
form.sections: I General Market Conditions, II Subject Marketability, III Competitive Closed Sales, IV Competitive Listings, and the adjustment grids

subject.what: the subject property: Pending at $151,800, 3 bed / 1 bath, 1,158 sqft, built 1928, condition 'Major Rehab Needed', tax assessed $241,200
subject.why_it_matters: the story of the video is the gap between $151,800 as-is and ~$400k renovated -- that gap is what the BPO has to document

scope.what: Northline Restoration Co. rehabilitation budget for 946 Alderwick St -- demolition $10,500, roofing $9,500, HVAC $8,500, flooring $5,500, plus drywall, kitchen, plumbing, paint, cleanup

inputs._assets_are_committed: These nine PDFs live under assets/ and are IN GIT on purpose, against the convention that project content is gitignored. The precedent is the failure this project exists to avoid: projects/neaCnEawvbk kept only its manifests, its sources are gone, and the video it made cannot be rebuilt or re-cut today. 490 KB of synthetic data is a cheap price for a reproducible demo, and nothing here is real -- the addresses, MLS numbers, licences and phone numbers are invented.

notes: Predecessor: neaCnEawvbk, 'How to fill out BPO forms with AI | Residential Broker Price Opinion', 9:14, with three vertical shorts. This project is NOT a re-cut of it -- the requirement is a new recording of the same form on the same data.
